performance.verdict: Spend is landing; 11 conversions are invisible — attribution, not ads, is broken.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $1,045.48 spent over 28 days, 0 CRM leads recorded despite 11 Google Ads conversions — attribution pipeline is severed.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 (Aug 31 deadline missed) — GHL speed-to-lead automations likely routing to an empty seat, blocking scale-up gate.
5 additional overdue SOW milestones (booking bot, Review Boost, financing page, Homer Glen branch, LSA heating toggle) — all past Aug 31 / Sep 1 deadlines with no completion recorded.
GBP actions fell -34.48% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2) show 0 GBP actions vs avg 4.6/day prior 3 days — organic visibility is dropping while paid spend rose 22.9%.
Google spend is highly erratic: 28-day series shows spikes to $130.18 (Aug 15) and $97.13 (Sep 1) alongside $0 days — pacing instability suggests campaign budget type or throttling misconfiguration.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL webhook and Google Ads conversion action — trace why 11 platform conversions produce 0 CRM leads before next dollar is spent.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 11 conversions over 28 days on $1,045.48 spend, but GHL shows 0 leads — the CRM intake pipeline is broken somewhere between the ad platform and GHL. Audit the Google Ads conversion action tag, the GHL webhook endpoint, and confirm the receiving seat is active (Vivian's replacement per F2). Success is confirmed when a test conversion fires and appears as a GHL contact within 5 minutes. Complete by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner name, GHL login, and after-hours coverage — this single gap blocks all budget scale-up per SOW gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake owner seat has been unconfirmed for nearly 2 months, past the Aug 31 SOW deadline. Speed-to-lead automations are pointing at a potentially empty seat, which would explain the 0-lead CRM result alongside 11 platform conversions. Get a confirmed name, active GHL login, and after-hours coverage plan from Nader or Xavier by 2026-09-05. Success: named owner confirmed in writing and verified logged into GHL.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions for 3 more days; if daily average stays at 0 (vs prior 4.6/day), escalate to GBP audit.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 2) against a prior 3-day average of 4.6/day, and the 7-day delta is -34.48%. This may reflect posting/engagement lag or a listing issue. No action yet — monitor through 2026-09-06. If the daily total stays at 0 or below 1 by that date, escalate to a full GBP listing audit (posts, Q&A, category, suspension check).
